title: 第15章 被上一课第16章 旱灾到来
content_zh:
追梦把自己要培养的跟班一切都安排好后，追梦自己也要锻炼一下身体。
追梦现在的身体需要大量的能量补充。
家里银钱多，这段时间追梦每天都会购买一些人参，灵芝等药材来补充身体亏空，身体一天比一天好起来。
起源6180年6月底，是追梦穿越过来的12年零2个月，也就是追梦解封一部记忆已有2个月。
由于长时间服用低年份的药材，这些低年份的凡品药材对追梦的身体能量补充已经作用不大。
这天，追梦从好友李承志那里打探到，在柳城中心，城主府那有一个修炼者交易的市场，名为柳市。
柳市是专门买卖修炼者所使用的物品，由城主府城主亲自撑管。
即使在柳城里，一般普通人都不知道，只有极少数高官权贵才能知晓一点。
李承志，也是一次偶然的情况下，听到他父亲与人交谈中得知。
听到在柳城有专门为修炼者交易的柳市，追梦连忙让李承志带着自己去见李志强。
“李叔！”
远远的，追梦看到李志强就开始打招呼。
“是追梦小子啊！
你可是大忙人一个，今天怎么有时间来看叔啦。”
李志强一脸高兴的说道。
“是啊！
李叔，有几好天没见啦。
挺想念你的，这不，今天有空来看你了。”
追梦有点不好意思道。
“你小子，无事不登三宝殿。

叔还不知道你的脾气，有事快说。”
李志强一眼识破了追梦的伎俩，没好气的说道。
“还是李叔了解我。
那小侄就不矫情了。
听说柳城有一个专门为修炼者交易的市场，名为柳市，不知李叔是否知道如何进去交易？”
见李志强一眼看破自己的虚伪，追梦也就不拐弯抹角，直接问道。
“你说这事儿！
你小子从哪里打探到的？”
李志强很惊讶道。
“这你别管，你就告诉我一下如何进去买东西就可以。”
追梦说到，眼睛不经意的瞟了一眼李承志。
“哦，这样啊。”
李志强看追梦看了一眼李承志，就已经知道原因，也不责备李承志，一脸原来如此的说道。
“李叔，那你就给小侄说说呗。”
content_en:
After Zhui Meng has arranged everything for the followers he wants to train, Chai Meng himself also needs to exercise.
Chasing Dreams’ current body requires a lot of energy replenishment.
The family has a lot of money. During this period, Zhui Meng would buy some ginseng, Ganoderma lucidum and other medicinal materials every day to supplement the body's deficit, and the body was getting better day by day.
Origin: The end of June 6180, which is 12 years and 2 months after Dream Chaser traveled back in time, which means it has been 2 months since Dream Chaser unblocked a memory.
Due to the long-term use of low-aged medicinal materials, these low-aged ordinary medicinal materials have little effect on supplementing the energy of Chasing Dream's body.
On this day, Zhui Meng found out from his friend Li Chengzhi that in the center of Liucheng, there was a market for cultivators at the City Lord's Mansion, called Liushi.
Liushi is specialized in buying and selling items used by cultivators, and is personally managed by the city lord of the city lord's palace.
Even in Liucheng, ordinary people don't know about it, and only a few high-ranking officials and dignitaries know something about it.
Li Chengzhi also learned about it by chance when he overheard his father talking to someone.
Hearing that there was a Liushi market in Liucheng that specialized in trading for cultivators, Zhui Meng quickly asked Li Chengzhi to take him to see Li Zhiqiang.
"Uncle Li!"
From a distance, Zhui Meng saw Li Zhiqiang and started to say hello.
“It’s the dream boy!
You are a very busy person, how can you have time to visit your uncle today? "
Li Zhiqiang said happily.
"Yeah!
Uncle Li, I haven’t seen you for a few days.
I miss you very much. No, I have time to see you today. "
Chai Meng said a little embarrassed.
"You kid, don't go to the Three Treasures Palace for anything.
Uncle doesn’t know your temper yet, so tell me if you have anything to say. "
Li Zhiqiang saw through Dream Chaser's trick at a glance and said angrily.
"Uncle Li still understands me.
That nephew is no longer pretentious.
I heard that there is a market specifically for cultivators in Liucheng called Liushi. I wonder if Uncle Li knows how to enter and trade? "
Seeing that Li Zhiqiang saw through his hypocrisy at a glance, Meng Zhui didn't mince words and asked directly.
"You said this!
Where did you find out about this? "
Li Zhiqiang was surprised.
"Don't worry about it. Just tell me how to get in and buy something."
Zhui Meng said, and glanced at Li Chengzhi inadvertently.
"Oh, that's it."
Li Zhiqiang looked at Zhui Meng and Li Chengzhi and already knew the reason. He did not blame Li Chengzhi and said as if that was the case.
"Uncle Li, just tell my nephew."
